title: Omuwuubaza wa Zaabu mu Ddungu
intro: Kuba akafaananyi ng’olina enkambi ennene ey’eddungu mu kaseera akatono ng’olindirira era nga tolina bukakafu. Omukulembeze omukulu agenze okusisinkana n’Obwakatonda, n’alekawo ekitundu ekyettanira ekintu ekirabika okunywerera. Mu kuyimirira okwo okutali kwa mirembe, omuntu asikiriza agenda mu maaso n’ebisuubizo ebimasamasa n’ekitonde eky’amagezi ekirabika ng’ekiramu.
clues: Nze nali mu abo abaava e Misiri ne Musa, nga ndaba ennyanja ng’eyawukana olw’okudduka kwaffe.
Natunula omukulembeze waffe bwe yagenda ku lusozi okumala ekiro amakumi ana okufuna obulagirizi.
Nakung’aanya eby’okwewunda okuva mu bantu ne mbibumba n’emikono gyange.
Nakola ennyana eyawa eddoboozi ery’okuwuubaala, era ne mpita abantu ne ngijja.
Naggya enfuufu engalo ku luguudo lw’omubaka ne ngisuula mu bye nnakola.
Nayolekedde Musa n’avumirira okugamba nti ‘tonkwatako’ n’okubeera nga baawukanye, ng’olukiiko lusuubiziddwa okusalirwa omusango.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
